ℹ About PID configuration

Applying PID stops the motor, writes kp/ki/kd through the diagnostic stream, sets the position integral limit to 0.0, and persists the configuration to flash.

ℹ About Velocity Mode

Velocity mode sends position=NaN, the firmware sentinel for velocity-only tracking. kp provides disturbance rejection; kd provides velocity damping. The moteus uses a single integrated PID.

ℹ Platform Notes

The controller runs on the robot and communicates with this page over a WebSocket. Transport auto-discovery supports fdcanusb and Linux SocketCAN.
